title: 埃米·诺特数学著作全集——完整简体中文版 / Emmy Noether: Complete Simplified Chinese Corpus Edition

预览完整简体中文读本 / 直接下载 PDF.

这是埃米·诺特维护范围内数学著作全集的独立简体中文版：43 篇编号论文、两项编号论文之后单独标识的著作/范围，以及末尾书目和版本附录。该版按 NOETH-DE-AUTH-v047-20260808 / ED0011 覆盖德文权威文本逻辑行 1–24,146。公开读本含一页 DOI 版次说明和 424 页经机器验证的正文。可编辑 TeX、字体与 CMap、变更和来源范围、确定性构建、双提取、424 页正文渲染验证及精确哈希保存在源文件和证据 ZIP 中。

This is the standalone PRC-oriented Simplified-Chinese edition of the complete maintained Emmy Noether corpus: 43 numbered papers, two separately identified post-numbered works/scopes, and terminal bibliography/editorial apparatus. The 425-page public reader consists of one DOI cover plus the unchanged 424-page machine-validated r10b body. DataCite intent: this edition IsTranslationOf the same-scope source corpus represented by 10.5281/zenodo.20412587 and IsPartOf that multilingual hub. No Traditional-Chinese, Singapore, Taiwan, Hong Kong, or Macao localization is claimed. No external, community, or human certification is claimed.
